731:t_007:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Thanks to you, the $$スフィア$$s inside me are growing more active.」

731:t_007:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now you understand, don't you? Your power can't kill me.」

731:t_007:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「A cheap provocation. Do you think that's enough to shake us?」

731:t_007:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then silence me with your strength, not your words.」

731:t_007:5.en:
$n
「You don't need to tell me that!」

731:t_007:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Heh... I'm expecting great things from you.」

731:t_008:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Not yet...! It's still not enough!」

731:t_009:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn! He recovered the damage again!」

731:t_009:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「This regeneration...! It's beyond any $$スフィア・リアクター$$ we've fought so far!」

731:t_009:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「So this is his immortal power.」

731:t_009:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Even I don't know how it works.」

731:t_009:5.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「But one thing is certain: he himself does not wish for eternity.」

731:t_009:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You seem to understand me a little.」

731:t_009:7.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Fellow sufferers pity one another, as they say. But at least I know a way to die, which makes me better off than you.」

731:t_009:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Heh heh... I envy you.」

731:t_009:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What do we do?! At this rate it'll never end, no matter how long we keep at it!」

731:t_009:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Sooner or later, we'll be the ones to run out of strength...」

731:t_009:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「There's no such thing as absolute or infinite in this world! Keep pounding away and it'll break someday!」

731:t_009:12.en:
$$メール$$
「That's right! If it didn't, repairmen like me would all be out of a job!」

731:t_009:13.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That passion... I don't dislike it.」

731:t_009:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then quit fighting! This time I'll teach you the taste of booze for real!」

731:t_009:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We've got no choice but to keep hitting him...! It's a contest of endurance: does his infinity run out first, or do we!」

731:t_009:18.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's do it! Third time's the charm!」

731:t_009:19.en:
$$桂$$
「What happens twice will happen a third time, so don't let your guard down!」

731:t_009:20.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Come, then. Can you overcome infinity?」

731:t_010:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$アサキム$$'s unit has taken over 50% damage!」

731:t_010:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「All right...! His regeneration isn't activating!」

731:t_010:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Looks like he's run out of magic tricks!」

731:t_010:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Then from here on, we just keep pushing!」

731:t_010:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Can you really do it?」

731:t_010:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And even if you were to break the wings of $$シュロウガ・シン$$...」

731:t_010:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hold it, $$アサキム$$! Save what comes after that for when we get there!」

731:t_010:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All we'll do is concentrate on stopping you!」

731:t_010:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Very well! Then our true battle begins here!」

731:t_011:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Are you watching, $$サクリファイ$$?! This is life... the thing you all lost!」

731:t_011:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Clashing it against each other is what battle is! Yes... life itself is what gives birth to the future!」

731:t_011:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「He still had power in reserve!」

731:t_011:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Bring it on! It ain't a decisive battle unless both sides give it everything they've got!」

731:t_011:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We'll overcome that! And we'll seize victory!」

731:t_011:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But I'll soar above even that! On these black wings of sin that transcend causality!」

731:t_011:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now, $$シュロウガ・シン$$! Let us show them the end of the great kalpa!」

731:t_012:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「Here we go, $$エスター$$! $$Ｚクリスタル$$, full drive!」

731:t_012:3.en:
$$エスター$$
「Roger! D-Energy sync is good!」

731:t_014:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You of all people should understand, $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$. That my power is growing even at this very moment.」

731:t_014:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is it because you didn't merely use the four $$スフィア$$s as organs for drawing out $$次元力$$, but became the Reactor yourself...」

731:t_014:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$ is a $$スフィア・リアクター$$... And he's drawing out the power of each of the four $$スフィア$$s...!?」

731:t_014:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Come to think of it, he did use the power of the $$知りたがる山羊$$ when he beat $$アイム#pilot$$, but...」

731:t_014:6.en:
$n
「Impossible! Even $$ヴィルダーク$$ couldn't use any power other than that of his own $$スフィア$$, the $$立ち上がる射手$$!」

731:t_014:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You and I differ in the very root of our existence. That is why I could do it.」

731:t_015:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Inside the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on Mars, I kept thinking... what on earth am I?」

731:t_015:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The answer is that I, too, am human... that I want to live, at the very least, as a human.」

731:t_015:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is what gave me the means to draw out the power of the $$スフィア$$s.」

731:t_015:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$知りたがる山羊$$... I desired the knowledge of the entire universe, and touched the $$アカシックレコード$$...」

731:t_015:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$夢見る双魚$$... And I dreamed of the day my own wish would be granted...」

731:t_015:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$偽りの黒羊$$... For that, I hid my true intentions and, for a time, joined hands with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

731:t_015:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$... I loved you all.」

731:t_015:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No... to be precise, it wasn't me. Whatever created me loved your existence.」

731:t_015:10.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Those who burn their finite lives and live with all they've got... Their fighting spirit that yields to nothing is boundless freedom...」

731:t_015:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It is dear to me... and worthy of love.」

731:t_015:13.en:
$n
「But if you're a Reactor for four, there's a way!」

731:t_016:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$! Did you come all this way just to be hunted by me!」

731:t_016:1.en:
$n
「Drawing out the power of multiple $$スフィア$$s is the reason you'll lose!」

731:t_017:1.en:
$n
「By drawing out the power of multiple $$スフィア$$s, you've come close to the original form of $$至高神ソル$$...」

kept_omissions: 731:t_010:6: Rand's 'what comes after that' - what follows is left unspecified, as in the Japanese

uncertain: 731:t_010:6 Rand's そこから先は楽しみにしてな - read as 'save what comes after for when we get there' (teasing interruption); could also mean 'look forward to what we do next'

731:t_011:7 一大劫 = 'great kalpa' (Buddhist aeon); no glossary entry
731:t_011:0 君達 (Asakim to Sacrifice) read as plural 'you all' = Sacrifice and her kind
731:t_009:7 同病相哀れむ = 'fellow sufferers pity one another'
731:t_012:3 Ｄエナジー = plain 'D-Energy' (no glossary entry); 731:t_012:1 チーフ = 'Chief' (Traia)
